name: Stock Reconciliation
job: Capture physical stock counts as a draft, show differences, and let a manager explicitly approve reconciliation events.
incomingHandoff: A worker has physically counted selected ingredients at a location.
outgoingHandoff: The count remains a draft until a manager reviews and approves the exact stock differences.
responsiveBehaviour: Keep item, system quantity, counted quantity, difference, and unit attached; stack records on mobile and preserve the approval warning.

layoutContract.containment: A compact page header and numbered workflow guide keep counting, difference review, and manager approval distinct with no hidden action.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Content padding does not define primitive bounds.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted until its semantic owner and edge behavior are chosen.

motionContract.justification: Differences and approval state remain static and reviewable.
